verses.original: Διώκετε τὴν ἀγάπην δὲ ζηλοῦτε τὰ πνευματικά δὲ μᾶλλον ἵνα προφητεύητε
verses.transliteration: Diōkete tēn agapēn de zēloute ta pneumatika de mallon hina prophēteuēte
verses.literal: Earnestly pursue - love and eagerly desire - spiritual gifts - especially [the gift] of prophecy

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ οὐκ λαλεῖ ἀνθρώποις ἀλλὰ Θεῷ γὰρ οὐδεὶς ἀκούει δὲ λαλεῖ μυστήρια πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: gar ho lalōn glōssē ouk lalei anthrōpois alla Theō gar oudeis akouei de lalei mystēria pneumati
verses.literal: For he who speaks in a tongue vvv does not speak to men but to God Indeed no one understands [him] - he utters mysteries in the Spirit

verses.original: δὲ ὁ προφητεύων λαλεῖ ἀνθρώποις οἰκοδομὴν καὶ παράκλησιν καὶ παραμυθίαν
verses.transliteration: de ho prophēteuōn lalei anthrōpois oikodomēn kai paraklēsin kai paramythian
verses.literal: But he who prophesies speaks to men [for their] edification - encouragement and comfort

verses.original: ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ οἰκοδομεῖ ἑαυτὸν δὲ ὁ προφητεύων οἰκοδομεῖ ἐκκλησίαν
verses.transliteration: ho lalōn glōssē oikodomei heauton de ho prophēteuōn oikodomei ekklēsian
verses.literal: The [one who] speaks in a tongue edifies himself but the [one who] prophesies edifies [the] church

verses.original: δὲ Θέλω πάντας ὑμᾶς λαλεῖν γλώσσαις δὲ μᾶλλον ἵνα προφητεύητε δὲ ὁ προφητεύων μείζων ἢ ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσαις ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ διερμηνεύῃ ἵνα ἡ ἐκκλησία λάβῃ οἰκοδομὴν
verses.transliteration: de Thelō pantas hymas lalein glōssais de mallon hina prophēteuēte de ho prophēteuōn meizōn ē ho lalōn glōssais ektos ei mē diermēneuē hina hē ekklēsia labē oikodomēn
verses.literal: - I wish that all of you could speak in tongues but {I would} rather have you prophesy - He who prophesies [is] greater than [one who] speaks in tongues unless . . . . . . he interprets so that the church may be edified

verses.original: Νῦν δέ ἀδελφοί ἐὰν ἔλθω πρὸς ὑμᾶς λαλῶν γλώσσαις τί ὠφελήσω ὑμᾶς ἐὰν μὴ λαλήσω ὑμῖν ἢ ἐν ἀποκαλύψει ἢ ἐν γνώσει ἢ ἐν προφητείᾳ ἢ ἐν διδαχῇ
verses.transliteration: Nyn de adelphoi ean elthō pros hymas lalōn glōssais ti ōphelēsō hymas ean mē lalēsō hymin ē en apokalypsei ē en gnōsei ē en prophēteia ē en didachē
verses.literal: Now - brothers if I come to you speaking in tongues how will I benefit you unless . . . I [bring] you - - [some] revelation or - knowledge or - prophecy or - teaching

verses.original: ὅμως τὰ ἄψυχα διδόντα φωνὴν εἴτε αὐλὸς εἴτε κιθάρα πῶς γνωσθήσεται τὸ αὐλούμενον ἢ τὸ κιθαριζόμενον δῷ ἐὰν μὴ τοῖς φθόγγοις διαστολὴν
verses.transliteration: homōs ta apsycha didonta phōnēn eite aulos eite kithara pōs gnōsthēsetai to auloumenon ē to kitharizomenon dō ean mē tois phthongois diastolēn
verses.literal: Even in the case of - lifeless instruments . . . such as [the] flute or harp how will [anyone] recognize [the tune] . . . . . . . . . . . . they are playing unless . . . the notes are distinct

verses.original: Καὶ γὰρ ἐὰν σάλπιγξ δῷ ἄδηλον φωνὴν τίς παρασκευάσεται εἰς πόλεμον
verses.transliteration: Kai gar ean salpinx dō adēlon phōnēn tis paraskeuasetai eis polemon
verses.literal: Again . . . if [the] trumpet sounds a muffled call who will prepare for battle

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐὰν μὴ δῶτε εὔσημον λόγον διὰ τῆς γλώσσης πῶς γνωσθήσεται τὸ λαλούμενον γὰρ ἔσεσθε λαλοῦντες εἰς ἀέρα
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hymeis ean mē dōte eusēmon logon dia tēs glōssēs pōs gnōsthēsetai to laloumenon gar esesthe lalountes eis aera
verses.literal: So [it is] with you Unless . . . you speak intelligible words with [your] tongue how will [anyone] know what you are saying vvv You will [ just ] be speaking into [the] air

verses.original: εἰ τύχοι εἰσιν Τοσαῦτα γένη φωνῶν ἐν κόσμῳ καὶ οὐδὲν ἄφωνον
verses.transliteration: ei tychoi eisin Tosauta genē phōnōn en kosmō kai ouden aphōnon
verses.literal: vvv Assuredly there are many different languages in [the] world yet none [of them is] without meaning

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν μὴ εἰδῶ τὴν δύναμιν τῆς φωνῆς ἔσομαι βάρβαρος τῷ λαλοῦντι καὶ ὁ λαλῶν βάρβαρος ἐν ἐμοὶ
verses.transliteration: ean oun mē eidō tēn dynamin tēs phōnēs esomai barbaros tō lalounti kai ho lalōn barbaros en emoi
verses.literal: If then vvv I do not know the meaning of someone’s language I am a foreigner to the speaker and vvv [he is] a foreigner to me

verses.original: Οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπεὶ ἐστε ζηλωταί πνευμάτων ζητεῖτε πρὸς ἵνα περισσεύητε τὴν οἰκοδομὴν τῆς ἐκκλησίας
verses.transliteration: Houtōs kai hymeis epei este zēlōtai pneumatōn zēteite pros hina perisseuēte tēn oikodomēn tēs ekklēsias
verses.literal: It is the same . . . with you Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts strive . . . to excel [in gifts that] build up the church

verses.original: Διὸ ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ προσευχέσθω ἵνα διερμηνεύῃ
verses.transliteration: Dio ho lalōn glōssē proseuchesthō hina diermēneuē
verses.literal: Therefore the [one who] speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret

verses.original: γὰρ ἐὰν προσεύχωμαι γλώσσῃ μου τὸ πνεῦμά προσεύχεται δὲ μου ὁ νοῦς ἐστιν ἄκαρπός
verses.transliteration: gar ean proseuchōmai glōssē mou to pneuma proseuchetai de mou ho nous estin akarpos
verses.literal: For if I pray in a tongue my - spirit prays but my - mind is unfruitful

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐστιν προσεύξομαι τῷ πνεύματι δὲ καὶ προσεύξομαι τῷ νοΐ ψαλῶ τῷ πνεύματι δὲ καὶ ψαλῶ τῷ νοΐ
verses.transliteration: Ti oun estin proseuxomai tō pneumati de kai proseuxomai tō noi psalō tō pneumati de kai psalō tō noi
verses.literal: What then [shall I do] I will pray with [my] spirit but vvv I will also pray with [my] mind I will sing with [my] spirit but vvv I will also sing with [my] mind

verses.original: ἐπεὶ ἐὰν εὐλογῇς ἐν πνεύματι πῶς ὁ ἀναπληρῶν τὸν τόπον τοῦ ἰδιώτου ἐρεῖ τὸ Ἀμήν ἐπὶ σῇ τῇ εὐχαριστίᾳ ἐπειδὴ οἶδεν οὐκ τί λέγεις
verses.transliteration: epei ean eulogēs en pneumati pōs ho anaplērōn ton topon tou idiōtou erei to Amēn epi sē tē eucharistia epeidē oiden ouk ti legeis
verses.literal: Otherwise if you speak a blessing in spirit how {can} [someone] vvv vvv vvv vvv who is uninstructed say - Amen to your - thanksgiving since he does not know . . . what you are saying

verses.original: σὺ εὐχαριστεῖς μὲν γὰρ καλῶς ἀλλ’ ὁ ἕτερος οὐκ οἰκοδομεῖται
verses.transliteration: sy eucharisteis men gar kalōs all’ ho heteros ouk oikodomeitai
verses.literal: You {may} be giving thanks vvv vvv well enough but the other one vvv is not edified

verses.original: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ Θεῷ λαλῶ γλώσσαις μᾶλλον πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Eucharistō tō Theō lalō glōssais mallon pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: I thank - God that I speak in tongues more than all of you

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ θέλω λαλῆσαι πέντε μου τῷ νοΐ λόγους ἵνα καὶ κατηχήσω ἄλλους ἢ μυρίους λόγους ἐν γλώσσῃ
verses.transliteration: alla en ekklēsia thelō lalēsai pente mou tō noi logous hina kai katēchēsō allous ē myrious logous en glōssē
verses.literal: But in [the] church I would rather speak five vvv vvv coherent words to - instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue

verses.original: Ἀδελφοί μὴ ταῖς φρεσίν γίνεσθε παιδία ἀλλὰ τῇ κακίᾳ νηπιάζετε δὲ ταῖς φρεσὶν γίνεσθε τέλειοι
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi mē tais phresin ginesthe paidia alla tē kakia nēpiazete de tais phresin ginesthe teleioi
verses.literal: Brothers stop - thinking vvv like children - In [regard to] evil be infants but in [your] thinking be mature

verses.original: γέγραπται ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὅτι Ἐν ἑτερογλώσσοις καὶ ἐν ἑτέρων χείλεσιν λαλήσω τούτῳ τῷ λαῷ καὶ οὐδ’ οὕτως εἰσακούσονταί μου λέγει Κύριος
verses.transliteration: gegraptai en tō nomō hoti En heteroglōssois kai en heterōn cheilesin lalēsō toutō tō laō kai oud’ houtōs eisakousontai mou legei Kyrios
verses.literal: It is written in the Law - By strange tongues and - foreign lips I will speak to this - people [but] even then they will {not} listen to Me says [the] Lord

verses.original: γλῶσσαι Ὥστε αἱ εἰσιν εἰς σημεῖόν οὐ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἀλλὰ τοῖς ἀπίστοις ἡ δὲ προφητεία ἀλλὰ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν οὐ τοῖς ἀπίστοις
verses.transliteration: glōssai Hōste hai eisin eis sēmeion ou tois pisteuousin alla tois apistois hē de prophēteia alla tois pisteuousin ou tois apistois
verses.literal: Tongues then - are - a sign not for believers but for unbelievers - - Prophecy however [is] for believers not for unbelievers

verses.original: οὖν Ἐὰν ἡ ὅλη ἐκκλησία συνέλθῃ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ πάντες λαλῶσιν γλώσσαις δὲ ἰδιῶται ἢ ἄπιστοι εἰσέλθωσιν οὐκ ἐροῦσιν ὅτι μαίνεσθε
verses.transliteration: oun Ean hē holē ekklēsia synelthē epi to auto kai pantes lalōsin glōssais de idiōtai ē apistoi eiselthōsin ouk erousin hoti mainesthe
verses.literal: So if the whole church comes together . . . . . . and everyone speaks in tongues and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in vvv will they not say that you are out of your minds

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν τις ἄπιστος ἢ ἰδιώτης εἰσέλθῃ δέ πάντες προφητεύωσιν ἐλέγχεται ὑπὸ πάντων ἀνακρίνεται ὑπὸ πάντων
verses.transliteration: de ean tis apistos ē idiōtēs eiselthē de pantes prophēteuōsin elenchetai hypo pantōn anakrinetai hypo pantōn
verses.literal: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying he will be convicted - - [and] called to account by all

verses.original: τὰ κρυπτὰ τῆς αὐτοῦ καρδίας γίνεται φανερὰ καὶ οὕτως πεσὼν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον προσκυνήσει τῷ Θεῷ ἀπαγγέλλων ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς ἐστιν Ὄντως ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ta krypta tēs autou kardias ginetai phanera kai houtōs pesōn epi prosōpon proskynēsei tō Theō apangellōn hoti ho Theos estin Ontōs en hymin
verses.literal: [and] the secrets of his heart will be made known So . . . he will fall vvv facedown [and] worship - God proclaiming - - God is truly among you

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐστιν ἀδελφοί ὅταν συνέρχησθε ἕκαστος ἔχει ψαλμὸν ἔχει διδαχὴν ἔχει ἀποκάλυψιν ἔχει γλῶσσαν ἔχει ἑρμηνείαν πάντα γινέσθω πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν
verses.transliteration: Ti oun estin adelphoi hotan synerchēsthe hekastos echei psalmon echei didachēn echei apokalypsin echei glōssan echei hermēneian panta ginesthō pros oikodomēn
verses.literal: What then [shall we say] brothers When you come together everyone has a psalm [or] a teaching - a revelation - a tongue [or] an interpretation All [of these] must be done to build up [ the church ]

verses.original: Εἴτε τις λαλεῖ γλώσσῃ δύο ἢ τὸ πλεῖστον τρεῖς κατὰ καὶ ἀνὰ μέρος καὶ εἷς διερμηνευέτω
verses.transliteration: Eite tis lalei glōssē dyo ē to pleiston treis kata kai ana meros kai heis diermēneuetō
verses.literal: If anyone speaks in a tongue two or [at] most three [should speak] - in turn and someone must interpret

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν ᾖ μὴ διερμηνευτής σιγάτω ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ δὲ λαλείτω ἑαυτῷ καὶ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: de ean ē mē diermēneutēs sigatō en ekklēsia de laleitō heautō kai tō Theō
verses.literal: But if there is no interpreter he should remain silent in [the] church and speak [only] to himself and - God

verses.original: δὲ δύο ἢ τρεῖς Προφῆται λαλείτωσαν καὶ οἱ ἄλλοι διακρινέτωσαν
verses.transliteration: de dyo ē treis Prophētai laleitōsan kai hoi alloi diakrinetōsan
verses.literal: - Two or three prophets should speak and the others should weigh carefully [what is said]

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν ἀποκαλυφθῇ ἄλλῳ καθημένῳ ὁ πρῶτος σιγάτω
verses.transliteration: de ean apokalyphthē allō kathēmenō ho prōtos sigatō
verses.literal: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated the first [speaker] should stop

verses.original: γὰρ δύνασθε πάντες προφητεύειν καθ’ ἕνα ἵνα πάντες μανθάνωσιν καὶ πάντες παρακαλῶνται
verses.transliteration: gar dynasthe pantes prophēteuein kath’ hena hina pantes manthanōsin kai pantes parakalōntai
verses.literal: For you can all prophesy in [turn] so that everyone may be instructed and - encouraged

verses.original: καὶ πνεύματα προφητῶν ὑποτάσσεται προφήταις
verses.transliteration: kai pneumata prophētōn hypotassetai prophētais
verses.literal: - [The] spirits of prophets are subject to prophets

verses.original: γάρ ἐστιν οὐ ὁ Θεὸς ἀκαταστασίας ἀλλὰ εἰρήνης Ὡς ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῶν ἁγίων
verses.transliteration: gar estin ou ho Theos akatastasias alla eirēnēs Hōs en pasais tais ekklēsiais tōn hagiōn
verses.literal: For [God] is not - a God of disorder but of peace as in all the churches of the saints

verses.original: αἱ γυναῖκες σιγάτωσαν ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις γὰρ οὐ αὐταῖς ἐπιτρέπεται λαλεῖν ἀλλὰ ὑποτασσέσθωσαν καθὼς ὁ νόμος καὶ λέγει
verses.transliteration: hai gynaikes sigatōsan en tais ekklēsiais gar ou autais epitrepetai lalein alla hypotassesthōsan kathōs ho nomos kai legei
verses.literal: - Women are to be silent in the churches - vvv They are not permitted to speak but must be in submission as the law - says

verses.original: δέ εἰ θέλουσιν μαθεῖν τι ἐπερωτάτωσαν τοὺς ἰδίους ἄνδρας ἐν οἴκῳ γάρ ἐστιν αἰσχρὸν γυναικὶ λαλεῖν ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: de ei thelousin mathein ti eperōtatōsan tous idious andras en oikō gar estin aischron gynaiki lalein en ekklēsia
verses.literal: - If they wish to inquire about something they are to ask [their] own husbands at home for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in [the] church

verses.original: Ἢ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐξῆλθεν ἀφ’ ὑμῶν ἢ εἰς ὑμᾶς μόνους κατήντησεν
verses.transliteration: Ē ho logos tou Theou exēlthen aph’ hymōn ē eis hymas monous katēntēsen
verses.literal: {Did} the word - of God originate with you Or - [are] you the only [ones] it has reached

verses.original: Εἴ τις δοκεῖ εἶναι προφήτης ἢ πνευματικός ἐπιγινωσκέτω ὅτι ἃ γράφω ὑμῖν ἐστὶν Κυρίου ἐντολή
verses.transliteration: Ei tis dokei einai prophētēs ē pneumatikos epiginōsketō hoti ha graphō hymin estin Kyriou entolē
verses.literal: If anyone considers [himself] a prophet or spiritual person let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is [the] Lord’s command

verses.original: δέ εἰ τις ἀγνοεῖ ἀγνοεῖται
verses.transliteration: de ei tis agnoei agnoeitai
verses.literal: But if anyone ignores this he himself will be ignored

verses.original: Ὥστε μου ἀδελφοί ζηλοῦτε τὸ προφητεύειν καὶ μὴ κωλύετε τὸ λαλεῖν γλώσσαις
verses.transliteration: Hōste mou adelphoi zēloute to prophēteuein kai mē kōlyete to lalein glōssais
verses.literal: So my brothers be eager - to prophesy and {do} not forbid - speaking in tongues

verses.original: δὲ πάντα γινέσθω εὐσχημόνως καὶ κατὰ τάξιν
verses.transliteration: de panta ginesthō euschēmonōs kai kata taxin
verses.literal: But everything must be done in a proper and vvv orderly [manner]
